fields.summary_ko.0: Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) rose 6.5% per share, with Q1 net income up 44% to $482 million and revenue up 39% to $3.44 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company acquired security partner Applied Compute for $4.5 billion to expand into AI model training and deployment, raising annual revenue growth guidance from 23-24% to 26-27%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Recent major outages at airlines, banks, and government agencies have increased cybersecurity demand, serving as a key catalyst for the stock rally.
